title: Detecting Opportunistic Cheaters in Volunteer Computing
access: Author manuscript, full mechanism sections reviewed
relevance: Closest prior art: independent scored search slices, random checks, score guessing assumption and toplist aggregation. No novelty claim for sampling or the hypergeometric bound.

title: Sabotage-tolerance mechanisms for volunteer computing systems
access: Publisher abstract and author conference manuscript
relevance: Spot checks, credibility, voting, backtracking. Long-lived reputation differs from disposable anonymous admission clients.

title: BOINC locality scheduling and persistent redundant computing
relevance: Deadline retries, canonical results, validation, data locality and replicated jobs are established engineering.

title: Smart distributed data factory volunteer computing platform for active learning-driven molecular data acquisition
relevance: Real molecular data tasks, atom-count volume estimates, validation. Molecular volunteer scheduling itself is not new.

title: Rigid and Flexible Ligand DOCKing
relevance: Rigid grid screening can be scientific when libraries are conformationally expanded. Our exact scoring bank is not the DOCK algorithm.

title: Hierarchical Docking of Databases of Multiple Ligand Conformations
relevance: Reuse of ligand structure and hierarchical scoring are legitimate scientific accelerations, which work-enforcement claims must allow/analyze.

title: Ligand Pose and Orientational Sampling in Molecular Docking
relevance: Orientation sampling, minimization and enrichment quality matter independently of score evaluation correctness.

title: DUD-E FA10
access: Dataset files downloaded with hashes in evaluation sources.json
relevance: Preselected 16 active plus 16 presumed-decoy pilot. Not experimentally verified negative binding labels.

title: Proof-of-Learning is Currently More Broken Than You Think
relevance: Execution checkpoints need attack analysis; correct or plausible final states do not imply expensive prior optimization.

title: Doubly Efficient Interactive Proofs for General Arithmetic Circuits with Linear Prover Time
relevance: GKR alternatives can have linear prover complexity; sublinear checking depends on circuit structure and input handling. No docking-specific overhead benchmark performed.

title: Libra: Succinct Zero-Knowledge Proofs with Optimal Prover Computation
relevance: Cryptographic/global consistency is more than sampling raw traces; linear asymptotics do not ensure minority overhead for a fast grid lookup kernel.

title: Interactive Proofs for Rounding Arithmetic
relevance: Rounding-aware protocols are a candidate research route, not evidence of a ready docking verifier.

title: Slalom
relevance: Freivalds-style linear algebra verification does not directly authenticate nonlinear grid lookups, quantized rounding or global minimum selection.

title: Proofs of Work from Worst-Case Assumptions
relevance: Explicit non-amortizability theorem for special fine-grained polynomial workloads; does not transfer to arbitrary docking or an arbitrary NP-hard optimizer. Prefer this updated work over the older incomplete PoUW definition.

title: Compact Proofs of Retrievability
relevance: Possession/retrievability and correct encoding do not establish that stored scientific values were freshly computed.

title: Ofelimos
relevance: Optimization designed jointly with security; browser admission adaptation and useful fraction remain unmeasured here.

title: FRLS
relevance: Related optimization-work efficiency design, not a ready per-request guarantee.

title: Efficient Verifiable Delay Functions
relevance: Compact verification of a dedicated delay computation under assumptions, but the delay work is not molecular work.
